title: Flat-facet Shell4 formulation matrix: rank census + Scordelis-Lo + pressurised cylinder

gates.quantity: max over the 4 (formulation, plate-shear) configurations of ||K phi_rigid|| / (||K|| ||phi||)
gates.reference: rigid-body modes must carry exactly zero strain energy in exact arithmetic

gates.quantity: |gauge_overlap - 1|: overlap between the legacy 6-mode mechanism and the identified drilling gauge mode
gates.reference: the extra zero mode of a flat facet is the nodal drilling rotation (7 zero modes expected, not 6)

gates.quantity: max spurious zero-energy modes per facet over the MITC transverse-shear configurations
gates.reference: MITC shear interpolation must leave no spurious mechanism

gates.quantity: min spurious zero-energy modes per facet over the SRI transverse-shear configurations
gates.reference: SRI shear integration is known to leave spurious mechanisms; the census must still see them
gates.note: This gate PASSES on a defect. It exists so that an accidental 'repair' of the census, or a genuine future fix of SRI, cannot pass unnoticed: it forces re-baselining.

gates.quantity: max |null(K_assembled) - 7| over the flat meshes with MITC transverse shear (n = 2, 3, 4)
gates.reference: 7 = 6 rigid-body modes + 1 nodal drilling gauge per connected flat mesh

gates.quantity: min spurious null modes over the assembled flat meshes with SRI transverse shear
gates.reference: the per-facet SRI mechanism survives assembly (it is not integrated away)
gates.note: integer count: >= 0 means 'at least one spurious null mode survives assembly'

gates.reference: Scordelis & Lo (1964) cylindrical-roof benchmark, w_c = -0.3024 m (NAFEMS LE11 / MacNeal-Harder suite)
Scordelis & Lo (1964) cylindrical-roof benchmark, w_c = -0.3024 m (NAFEMS LE11 / MacNeal-Harder suite)

gates.quantity: observed order p of the shell4 + MITC shear ladder (n = 8, 16, 24), |error| ~ h^p
gates.reference: a accepted shell formulation must converge, p >= 1

gates.quantity: observed order p of the shell4 + SRI shear ladder: negative = the discretisation diverges
gates.reference: SRI on a bending-dominated shell must be reported as non-converging, not as 'small error'
gates.note: PASSES only while SRI diverges; a genuine fix turns this gate red and the baseline is re-derived.

gates.quantity: min |relative error| over the SRI configurations at the finest level
gates.reference: SRI must remain materially wrong (>10 %) on a bending-dominated shell

gates.quantity: max |w_r - w_exact| / w_exact over the four configurations at the finest ring (nt = 48)
gates.reference: thin-cylinder membrane state w_r = p R^2 / (E t), exact

gates.quantity: max | |u_axial / w_r| - nu/2 | over the finest ring of every configuration
gates.reference: closed-cylinder membrane state requires u_axial = -(nu/2) w_r (Poisson coupling), exact

gates.quantity: max relative ripple of the hoop displacement around the ring (all configurations, all nt)
gates.reference: an axisymmetric membrane state must be circumferentially uniform

gates.quantity: max |sum of nodal reactions| / (p R) over all configurations and rings
gates.reference: static equilibrium of the closed cylinder under internal pressure

gates.quantity: min observed order p over the four membrane ladders
gates.reference: a faceted cylinder is a quadratic geometry approximation: p must be >= 1.5

gates.quantity: number of distinct Scordelis-Lo mesh levels (n = [8, 16, 24])
gates.reference: the anchor must carry at least a three-level ladder

limitations: The Scordelis-Lo target -0.3024 m is the published converged FE value of the benchmark (four significant digits), not a closed form; the accepted configurations converge to -0.3054 m, i.e. a ~1 % offset that mesh refinement cannot remove. The 3 % gate therefore measures 'inside the published reference band', not 'analytic exactness'.

shell4_mitc + MITC stalls at 0.94 -> 0.99 % between n = 16 and 24 (order 1.49 by fit); the slight uptick is that model-vs-reference offset, so the ladder is graded by the smallest error reached, not by monotonicity.

The negative-control gates (A.sri_spurious_present, B.assembled_sri_spurious, C.scordelis_lo.order_sri, C.scordelis_lo.sri_degradation) pass while SRI is defective. They are intentional: they make the known deficiency a checkable claim instead of prose. If SRI is ever fixed they turn red and this file must be re-baselined.

The rank census is a linear-algebra statement about the element matrices at one facet (Y = 200 GPa, nu = 0.3, t = 10 mm). It does not by itself prove mesh-level stability for non-flat (warped) facets or for nonlinear kinematics.
Flat-facet Shell4 cannot represent a curved shell exactly: the membrane block's error is O(h^2) purely from chord-vs-arc geometry, which is why its order is 2 and not better.

Every number is float64 torch on CPU; the machine-precision invariant gates are set at 1e-8..1e-10, four to seven decades above the observed 1e-12..1e-16 noise, so they detect a formulation error rather than a compiler difference.
